subject: literacy
concept: Identifying an author's bias or perspective in a persuasive text
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student compares two persuasive passages on the same topic written from opposite perspectives
exercise.pictorial: Student circles the word choices in a passage that reveal the author's bias
exercise.abstract: Student states an author's likely perspective and the evidence that reveals it

misconception_flags: treats a persuasive text as fully neutral/objective

interest_binding: passage content generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
